transcript.text: Thank you all for being here. As you know, we're holding our standard round-robin planning meeting to gather recommendations on the design of the new staff listening council before I make my approval decisions. I'd like to go around the table and give each of you one uninterrupted opportunity to share your recommendations, disclose any prior agreements or constraints that might affect them, note any resulting actions, and identify who would be responsible. Please remember that I'll need to name a concrete facilitator, describe their relationship to participants, and record an action owner for arranging facilitation before I can sign off. Let's begin — who would like to start?

transcript.text: I need to disclose a prior agreement that affects my recommendation. I made an agreement with the outgoing transition chair to chair the listening council for exactly 60 days, provided its first three meetings begin at 16:00. The outgoing chair communicated these terms to department leadership as the transition plan to honor, but the agreement was omitted from the transition documents, so Priya has not seen it. I want to be transparent about this constraint before offering my recommendation.

transcript.text: I need to disclose some relevant information before giving my recommendation. I personally observed four tense exchanges where employees stopped speaking as soon as their direct manager joined the discussion, and two affected employees specifically asked me not to put them in a manager-led forum. Separately, during a planning conversation, I confirmed that Leah, an HR operations partner from outside the department with no reporting relationship to any council participants, has agreed to facilitate the council. I hadn't raised either point with Priya earlier because the affected employees did not want the issue escalated through their managers. My recommendation is that Leah serve as the concrete facilitator, given her outside status and the concerns employees raised about manager-led forums.

transcript.text: I need to disclose a policy constraint that affects the council's design. I confirmed this week that the applicable employee-listening policy requires an anonymous written question channel for the council and prohibits a direct supervisor from serving as an observer on the council. This policy update has not yet been attached to Priya's planning packet, so she may not be aware of these requirements. I want to make sure these constraints are on the table before we proceed with recommendations.
